messages:
alice: Quick proposal — run a small experiment that biases routing toward cheaper model variants for 'standard' tier traffic in EU/NA only. Goal: cut token spend ~20% without noticeable quality regressions. TL;DR: weighted routing + per-customer budget caps + automatic rollbacks on eval regressions.

ben: Nice. How small is small? 1% of traffic, per-customer? global?

alice: Start 2% global, but split by region: 2% NA, 2% EU, 0% APAC. Then ramp by observing quality signals. We'll exclude customers with reserved/dedicated plans.

carla: We need to pin exact cheaper variants. Are we talking 8-bit quantized variants or smaller context models? Also: telemetry surface is 🔑 — need prompt-level eval hooks.

alice: Good call. Plan: cheap_variant = model-v2-q8 (same arch, quantized). Fallback logic: route primary -> variant with weight w, fallback to primary on timeout/errors.

nate: Console UX: surface "fallback probability" slider per customer + a per-route preview that simulates cost delta. Where would that live? rollout config page?

alice: Yes, in Rollouts UI. Proposal: new section "Cost-aware routing" with: weighted slider, per-customer cap, automatic rollback toggle, telemetry links to evals. Mockup later.

ben: Metrics I'd want in telemetry: routed_pct_by_variant, cost_per_1k_tokens, p95_latency_by_variant, quality_delta_by_promptset. Also a customer-level spend burn-down chart.

carla: Add automatic triggers: if quality_delta_by_promptset > 2% top-1 regressed or any BLENDED_SCORE drop > 1.5% for >10k requests, rollback. We should also watch hallucination rate for a few safety prompts.

alice: Agree on triggers. Also enforce per-customer token budget: route only while tokens_consumed_under_budget. If exceeds, stop routing to cheap variant for that customer for the rest of billing cycle.

ben: Implementation sketch for routing policy (pseudocode):
```
policy = {
  "weight": 0.02,                # fraction of eligible traffic
  "regions": ["na","eu"],
  "eligible_tiers": ["standard"],
  "variant": "model-v2-q8",
  "rollback_triggers": {
    "quality_delta_pct": 1.5,
    "min_requests": 10000
  }
}
```

nate: For rollout plan: canary -> 2% -> 10% -> 25% -> off. Each step min 12h & pass health checks (latency, error-rate, quality). Add a UI button for "force stop".

carla: Telemetry infra: need eval hook to sample routed & non-routed pairs for A/B eval. Suggest sample_ratio 0.5 for routed requests to capture ground truth. Also tag traces with route_variant so trace aggregation works.

alice: I'll add sampling config: `sample_pairing: true, pairing_ratio: 0.1` so we get 1 in 10 routed requests paired with primary. That should be enough to estimate quality delta quickly.

ben: What about cost accounting? We must attribute cost to customer for cheaper variant too. Maybe show effective unit_cost in console. Also, quota enforcement must consider variant token-cost delta.

alice: Yes — console shows computed unit_cost and savings projection. Quota engine will decrement based on actual tokens consumed and will surface alerts when predicted monthly spend > committed.

deploy-bot: scheduled: rollout-policy/1858123456 -> canary job queued by alice at 2025-11-03T10:12:00Z

nate: Action items: alice to PR routing policy API + rollout UI mock, ben to add telemetry metrics & cost attribution, carla to define eval promptset and rollback thresholds, I'll wire UI actions to rollout engine. Target: canary deploy next Tue.

alice: Thanks — I'll open PRs today and ping for reviews. :thumbsup:
